scientific_integrity: Originality is a literature-based assessment and is not certified; analytic proof and self-contained independent-formula numerical checks are provided. The all-horizon statement applies at the uniquely optimal orientation and step only.
scientific_limitations: Noise-free centered planar SPD quadratics with eigenvalues 1 and kappa>1, independent Rademacher probes, full curvature exponent alpha=1 and regularization floor one; Hessian-energy risk only. The empirical source recommends a smaller power; no nonlinear, high-probability, or practical training result is inferred. Relevant earlier broad randomized line-search literature has residual unindexed/full-text-overlap risk.
title: Exact orientation and batch-size minimax law for curvature-weighted Rademacher probes
